ARITHMETIC REPLAY (Python 3.11 or newer; standard library only)
From this phase_fusion_review directory:
  python3 frontier_fusion/check_frontier_fusion.py
  python3 frontier_fusion/independent_substitution_check.py

These replay the rational native moment and both outer ledgers, including
negative controls. They do not rerun the entire native supplier.

COMPLETE NATIVE REPLAY
Obtain CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds at exact commit
f852af5e178ce035cd46181a29d9330bcbcaa206. Follow the requirements in
research/gmx-t74-p566-ep400/ and run its unmodified verify.py with a fresh
--work directory and --audit-shards 4. The retained RESULT.json and
NATIVE-ADMISSION-BINDING.json identify the completed fresh run and bind
its native, owner, phase, invoice, arithmetic and control receipts.
The full 121 MB long-precision assembly and its vendor tree are not duplicated
in this review bundle. Their hashes are retained; obtain/replay the pinned
source to reproduce those larger files.

The two final exponents retain the inherited all-size hypotheses. The larger
value additionally assumes the supplied omega_C <= 9/4 theorem. Numerical and
finite native verification alone do not prove those external hypotheses.
